test_title: PYST 19: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 9 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

We will start the meeting as soon as all the members arrive.

options.text: The meeting is going to start as soon as all the members arrive.
The meeting is going to be started as soon as all the members arrive.
The meeting will be started as soon as all the members arrive.
The meeting is being started as soon as all the members arrive.

solution:
The correct answer is "**The meeting will be started as soon as all the members arrive.**"
